import io
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

DATA = """class,code,gedi_shots,agbd_Mg_ha,carbon_MgC_ha
tree cover,10,78921,132.86,62.442
grassland,30,4180,50.031,23.514
bare,60,34,49.33,23.185
built-up,50,2629,39.972,18.787
cropland,40,5612,25.848,12.148
shrubland,20,4,11.391,5.354
water,80,3,10.361,4.8698
"""
df = pd.read_csv(io.StringIO(DATA))

def plot_carbon(df):
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(6.6, 3.4))
    d = df.sort_values("carbon_MgC_ha")
    ax.barh(d["class"], d.carbon_MgC_ha, color=["#" + PALETTE[c] for c in d.code])
    for y, (v, n) in enumerate(zip(d.carbon_MgC_ha, d.gedi_shots)):
        ax.text(v, y, f"  {v:.0f}  (n={n:,})", va="center", fontsize=7)
    ax.set_xlabel("Above-ground carbon (Mg C/ha), mean of GEDI footprints")
    ax.set_title("The carbon lookup table, measured instead of assumed", loc="left",
                 fontsize=10)
    return fig

plot_carbon(df)
plt.show()
